summary: Reviewed BookmarkSettingsView.axaml. Both IsVisible binding changes are semantically correct: nudge StackPanel (line 30) and 'Add frame as thumbnail' CheckBox (line 89) now bind to CanNudge, which requires IsCreateMode AND ffmpegRunner available AND videoPath non-empty. The prior IsCreateMode binding would have shown these controls when ffmpeg was unavailable, making them non-functional. Apply Preset StackPanel (line 63) correctly retains IsCreateMode since it is independent of ffmpeg availability. Clean, targeted 2-line change with no regressions.

comments.note: Semantic correctness confirmed: CanNudge (IsCreateMode && _ffmpegRunner is not null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_videoPath)) is the correct guard for both the nudge StackPanel and the 'Add frame as thumbnail' CheckBox. The prior IsCreateMode binding was too permissive — it would show these controls even when ffmpeg was unavailable, rendering them non-functional. The new CanNudge binding hides them in that case, which is the correct UX. Apply Preset remains on IsCreateMode, which is correct since presets are independent of ffmpeg availability.
